summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes a 712KB obfuscated sibling payload unrelated to the package's declared purpose
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. On npm install, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (pinned to v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun into a temp directory, unpacks bun-<platform>.zip, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {cwd}). math_init.js is a ~712KB heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array rotation function WV8StW plus numeric constant table n7gIxM and a base64-style decoder alphabet, marked // @bun @bun-cjs) that has no functional relationship to the advertised Kibana log-sender library and is not imported by the package's declared main (dist/index.js). The alternate runtime is used specifically to run an obfuscated payload that Node-based tooling cannot inspect, and the entire chain fires automatically on any npm install without user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
